claim: The gateway's RateLimitGuard keeps its counters in one process's memory, and that is the whole limit because the gateway runs exactly one replica (.railway/railway.ts). When this fails because replicas went above 1, the per-process counters stop being a fleet-wide limit (each replica allows the full budget): move the store to a shared one (Redis via CacheService) before scaling.
verify: awk '/service\("@wineops\/api-gateway"/{f=1} f && /replicas:/{print; exit}' .railway/railway.ts | grep -q '{ "us-west2": 1 }' && grep -q 'private store: Map<string' apps/api-gateway/src/common/rate-limit/rate-limit.guard.ts
